Indispensable alto dominio de paquete MS Excel. • AutoCad básico • MS Project • Herramientas de estimación y APU (Lulowin o similares) • Trabajo en redes y nubes de información (archivos compartidos) Inglés (nivel intermedio – lectura / escritura)  5. ACTITUDES, PRINCIPIOS Y VALORES FUNDAMENTALES PARA EL PUESTO • Confiabilidad • Objetividad • Ética • Transparencia Este es un puesto a tiempo completo, presencial y ubicado en Caracas.

Minimum of 5 years’ experience at senior management, portfolio, programme, delivery lead, demand lead, technology manager or equivalent leadership level. Proven experience managing technology demand pipelines, initiative prioritisation, portfolio sequencing, delivery readiness or cross-functional technology planning. Strong experience working across business stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, PMO, Operations, Information Security, GRC, Finance, Procurement, suppliers and delivery teams. Experience preparing executive-level reporting, decision packs, portfolio dashboards, risk summaries, dependency views or delivery-readiness updates. Experience in a regulated environment such as insurance, financial services, public sector, state-owned entity, banking, telecommunications or similar is advantageous. Duties and Responsibilities: Technology Demand Intake and Pipeline Management Lead the technology demand intake process and maintain a transparent demand pipeline. Ensure business demand is captured, clarified, assessed and routed through clear governance and delivery channels. Demand Triage and Prioritisation Facilitate demand triage and prioritisation with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, PMO, Operations, GRC/Cyber, Finance, Procurement and delivery teams. Assess demand against value, risk, capacity, funding, supplier availability and operational impact. Solution Assessment and Delivery Readiness Coordinate early solution assessment and delivery-readiness gates. Align business outcomes, architecture input, risk and control requirements, operational readiness, support models and service acceptance before delivery or go-live. Portfolio Coordination and Sequencing: Coordinate portfolio sequencing across initiatives, teams and suppliers. Delivery Enablement and Governance-led Execution: Strengthen the transition of demand into feasible, delivery-ready technology initiatives. review_candidates.title: Head of Sales Europe
review_candidates.description: Build the next chapter of European growth Alicat Scientific Europe is entering an ambitious new phase of growth. To strengthen its commercial leadership, we are looking for a technically accomplished and entrepreneurial Head of Sales Europe who can translate market opportunities into a clear commercial strategy, accelerate sustainable growth and develop a high-performing, multicultural team. This is a newly created leadership position. Until now, responsibility for European sales has rested with the General Manager Europe. The appointment introduces a dedicated commercial leader who will take ownership of the European sales organisation and commercial plan, reporting directly to the General Manager and joining the Europe Leadership Team. About Alicat Scientific Alicat Scientific designs and manufactures precision mass flow and pressure measurement and control instruments used in industrial processes, research and technically demanding applications. Alicat Europe is the European operation of Alicat Scientific, headquartered in the United States and part of the Halma group. Europe runs its own commercial organisation and holds its own P\&L, with the technical expertise and resources of an international group behind it. Based in Duiven, Alicat Europe serves customers throughout the European market, both directly and through channel partners. Its customer base spans many sectors and markets, creating an opportunity to build a more focused, scalable commercial approach. As the European business develops, plans to establish local supply-chain and assembly capabilities will further strengthen its customer proposition. The Opportunity As Head of Sales Europe, you will design, own and execute the European commercial plan: selecting priority markets and segments, shaping direct and indirect routes to market, developing strategic accounts, strengthening the sales pipeline and driving revenue and margin performance. You will lead both new business development and growth within existing customer relationships, bringing commercial structure and discipline without losing entrepreneurial speed. You will have two direct reports leading inside and outside sales activities, with a total team of approximately ten professionals and further growth expected. The team is technically skilled, internationally diverse and customer focused. You will coach the two team leaders, develop capability throughout the organisation and create a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous learning. In a business of this size, you will also remain personally engaged with selected strategic customers and important commercial opportunities. Key responsibilities Create and deliver an evidence-based European commercial strategy, including market and country priorities, segmentation, channel choices, resource allocation and a clear growth roadmap. Own European sales performance, balancing sustainable revenue growth with margin, pricing discipline, pipeline quality and reliable forecasting. Develop existing customers, win new accounts and build relationships with larger, strategically important industrial and technology customers. Optimise both direct sales and indirect sales through distributors and channel partners across European markets. Lead, coach and further professionalise the inside and outside sales organisations through two established team leaders; support recruitment and future team expansion. Build an effective, collaborative approach across Sales, Marketing, Operations, application engineering and the US organisation. Improve commercial processes and CRM discipline, including opportunity management, quotation responsiveness, customer experience and forecast accuracy. Profile We are looking for a commercially driven leader with strong technical credibility, a genuine passion for building teams and a hands-on, scale-up mindset. You combine strategic thinking with the energy to make things happen, and you can demonstrate the impact you have made throughout your career. A completed technical Master of Science (MSc) degree is essential, preferably in Chemical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or a closely related technical discipline. At least ten years of people-management and commercial leadership experience, ideally across both inside and outside sales functions and through team leaders. Proven B2B technical sales experience across multiple European countries, including responsibility for European sales strategy, commercial planning and results. A track record of demonstrable accomplishments: tangible commercial growth, organisational improvements and successful coaching and development of people. Experience with both direct and indirect sales models, including distributor or channel management and complex customer structures. The ability to engage credibly with engineers and technical buyers; knowledge of instrumentation, process measurement, laboratory equipment or related technical products is a strong advantage. Experience working with multicultural teams, bringing empathy, cultural sensitivity, strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative leadership style. An entrepreneurial, ambitious and growth-oriented mindset, ideally shaped by exposure to both international corporate structures and smaller, fast-growing businesses. Fluent English is required. German and Dutch are both advantageous. Able to be present at the Duiven office on a regular weekly basis, alongside regular travel across Europe.

Present in 30 countries, the Group covers the entire energy value chain. The clusters are currently based on technology groupings and will be evaluated and adjusted periodically based on number/type of additional projects coming into operation, location, technology, complexity and business needs at the time. Embrace innovation and technology-forward solutions that lead to efficiency, competitive advantage or growth. Managing risks on behalf of the business and ensure that engineering decisions, standards, risks and behaviours consistently protect the business, its people and its assets. Specific responsibilities of the role include: Projects and Asset Support: Lead the technical aspects of projects in development including feasibility studies, design, bids/proposals, due diligence, technical solution, and selecting and managing Engineering consultants and suppliers, with the aim of improving bid competitiveness and securing sustainability and technical quality as required for Construction and O&M. Ensure proper integration of HSE requirements in the technical studies and contracts of the project. Ensure mobilization of required technical expertise from within ENGIE (Métiers, etc.). Contribute and/or be responsible for drafting and negotiating the Owner specification including up to date return on experience of the ENGIE Group. Be responsible for the quality and consistency of all technical related agreements (EPC, PPA, FSA, OMA, LTSA, OE and Grid Connection Agreements etc.) after consultation with Construction and Operations teams. Be in charge of defining procurement strategies (together with the Procurement Department) and construction strategies (together with the Construction Department), establishing construction planning, defining project implementation budgets, negotiating all manner of construction and service agreements. Prepare O&M budget integrating feedback from ENGIE plants and ENGIE Group. Prepare all O&M and technical related documents for the bid (O&M organization chart, O&M references, O&M philosophy, etc.). Prepare technical inputs for financial models (hard and soft project costs, (renewable) resource availability, fuel and other resources, availability, degradation, schedule, …) and provide support for internal project approval processes. Interface with Lender’s Engineer and support regarding the Lender’s due diligence process. Prepare qualitative hand-over documentation for Construction and Operations in collaboration with the BD team. Participate in the formal hand-over from the business development team to the construction team Support ProjCos and OpCos through SLAs, with advisory and punctual problem resolution during the construction, commissioning or operations phase. Maintain a technology watch and share technology knowledge within ESA, AMEA or the R&F GBU teams. Develop and maintain good knowledge of local technical consultants and engineering offices. Stakeholder Relations Coordinating internal stakeholders and departmental interfaces and ensuring services are well managed. Maintaining smooth relationships with all stakeholders while devoting best efforts to minimise and solve possible disputes in the best interest of the project/team Finance Managing department within approved budgetary limits; Controlling and approving procurement and all expenditures as per the DOA Reporting Reporting on the status of the assets to the ESA management team, Asset Managers and O&M Heads Resource Management Leading, coordinating and supporting the team in the execution of their responsibilities. Setting KPIs, managing team performance, tools and resources and implementing skills development plans COMMUNICATION AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS Internal Engie South Africa Management Team Engie South Africa Transversal & Support Functions O&M Heads and Asset Managers Engie AMEA, R&F GBU and Other Group BUs/Functions External Client / Off-Taker (ESKOM); Government and local authorities as required Contractual Counterparties: Suppliers, OEM, Contractors, Advisors, Vendors Lenders/banks Communities Peer Groups & Industry Bodies External QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS Education B Tech, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (or related field). Experience 10+ years of experience in Engineering within power generation, preferably in an IPP or utility environment. Strong understanding of power plant design, performance KPIs, yield assessments or thermodynamic modelling, and asset optimization. Proven ability to manage and mentor teams, with excellent leadership and communication skills. Experience working with both renewable and thermal generation assets is a plus. Specific Knowledge/Skills Strong ability to think strategically and lead complex assignments Strong interpersonal skills and ability to manage people/stakeholders/performance/conflict Strong analysis and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to performance improvement. Ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-plant operational environment. Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to work flexibly (independently and with teams), under complexity, ambiguity and with change. Ability to lead and motivate a team. Ability to work efficiently in a broad cultural spectrum. Process driven and maintains high ethical standard ENGIE Southern Africa (Pty) Ltd is committed to equality, employment equity, and diversity.
